en: This black-and-white image shows a large, elegant building partially obscured by mature trees and greenery. In the center background, a building with a high, pointed clock tower or spire emerges above the rooftops. The architecture suggests a historical European style, likely from the 18th or 19th century, characterized by a sloped roof, dormer windows, and formal garden or park around it.
